title: CCA-F Mini Quiz
description: 25 quick-check questions, 5 per domain. Written from the reviewer content (original questions, not from the live exam). answer is an array of option letters.

questions.q: Which signal should control whether the agentic loop keeps running tools?

options.D: Whether the response contains any text block

questions.why: stop_reason is the only reliable signal. A cap is a safety net, and replies can contain text AND tool_use together.

questions.q: The coordinator never spawns subagents even though its prompt says to. What is the first thing to check?
questions.why: Subagents are spawned with the Task tool. Without it in allowedTools the coordinator cannot delegate.

questions.q: Identity verification must happen before every refund, and 12% of cases currently skip it. What is the fix?

options.A: Add the rule in CAPS to the system prompt

questions.why: Mandatory ordering needs deterministic enforcement. Prompts have a non-zero failure rate.

questions.q: Select TWO correct statements about hooks.

options.C: PostToolUse can normalize results before Claude sees them

questions.why: PreToolUse runs before the tool and can deny. PostToolUse runs after and transforms output. Hooks are deterministic.

questions.q: Last week's session analysed files that have since changed heavily. Best approach?

options.C: New session seeded with a structured summary of valid findings

questions.why: Stale tool results make resumption unreliable. Keep the conclusions, discard the outdated evidence.

questions.q: Two similar tools keep being confused. What is the FIRST fix?

options.B: Expand the tool descriptions with inputs, examples and boundaries

questions.why: Descriptions are the main selection signal; this is the lowest-effort, highest-impact fix.

questions.q: A refund is rejected for violating policy. Which error metadata is right?

options.B: errorCategory: business, isRetryable: false, plus a customer-friendly explanation
options.C: A success result with an empty object

questions.why: Policy violations are non-retryable business errors the agent should explain, not retry.

questions.q: Document type is unknown, there is one extraction tool per type, and the model must never reply with plain text. Which tool_choice?
questions.why: any forces a tool call but lets Claude choose which schema.

questions.q: A new hire does not get the team's GitHub MCP server. Where was it most likely configured?
questions.why: User-level config is not shared. Move it to project .mcp.json and use ${ENV_VAR} for the token.

questions.q: Select TWO correct tool choices.

options.B: Glob to find where a function is called
options.C: Grep to find where a function is called
options.D: Grep to list file names matching a pattern

questions.why: Glob matches paths; Grep matches contents.

questions.q: Coding standards work for you but not for teammates. Where are they?
questions.why: User-level CLAUDE.md is personal. Move the standards into the project-level file and commit.

questions.q: A skill dumps thousands of lines of exploration into your main chat. Which frontmatter fixes it?
questions.why: context: fork runs the skill in an isolated sub-agent and returns only the result.

questions.q: Prettier must run after EVERY file edit regardless of whether Claude remembers. What do you use?

options.C: A PostToolUse hook with matcher Edit|Write in .claude/settings.json

questions.why: 'After every edit' / 'independent of instruction-following' means a hook.

questions.q: Which task suits plan mode?

options.A: Fix an off-by-one bug with a clear stack trace
options.C: Migrate an HTTP library across 45+ files with several viable approaches

questions.why: Large scale, several approaches and architectural impact justify planning first.

questions.q: Select TWO correct CI practices for Claude Code reviews.

options.B: Let the generating session review its own code
options.C: Use --output-format json with --json-schema for parseable findings

questions.why: Without -p the job hangs. JSON + schema gives parseable output. Use an independent reviewer and pass prior findings.

questions.q: 'Be conservative and only report high-confidence findings' did not reduce false positives. What does?

options.B: Explicit report/skip criteria with severity examples

questions.why: Vague wording has no operational content. Categorical criteria do.

questions.q: The model fabricates values for a required field that is sometimes absent. Schema-level fix?
questions.why: A required field leaves no honest answer. Nullable lets the model return null.

questions.q: An extraction field fails validation because the information is not in the document. What do you do?

options.B: Retry with the specific errors, up to 5 times
options.C: Do not retry; return null or route to human review

questions.why: Retries fix format/structure errors, not absent data.

questions.q: Select TWO accurate statements about the Message Batches API.

options.D: Supports multi-turn tool calling inside one request

questions.why: Up to 24 h with no SLA, correlated by custom_id, no mid-request tool calls.

questions.q: The session that generated code reviews it too gently. Why, and what is the fix?

options.A: It is polite; ask it to be harsher
options.B: It keeps its own reasoning and is biased; use an independent review instance

questions.why: Session context isolation matters. Self-review keeps the generator's bias.

questions.q: In a long support chat the agent misquotes refund amounts after summarization. Fix?

options.C: A persistent case facts block outside the summarized history

questions.why: Progressive summarization loses exact values. Persist them outside the summary.

questions.q: A customer's first message says 'I want a human, don't try to fix this yourself.' What should the agent do?

options.D: Gather order details first, then escalate

questions.why: An explicit request for a human is honored immediately.

questions.q: Select TWO correct behaviors when a search subagent fails.

options.A: Return an empty result as success
options.B: Retry transient failures locally, then propagate structured error + partial results
options.C: Distinguish access failure from a valid empty result
options.D: Stop the whole workflow on any failure

questions.why: Silent suppression and workflow termination are anti-patterns.

questions.q: After hours of exploration answers become generic ('typical patterns'). What helps?
questions.why: This is context degradation; externalize findings and keep verbose work out of the main context.

questions.q: Overall accuracy is 97%. Leadership wants to cut human review. What must come first?

options.B: Measure accuracy per document type and field, and keep stratified sampling of high-confidence results
options.C: Only review items the model flags

questions.why: Aggregate accuracy can hide weak segments.
